description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component 'Discover' for the FDroid app, including UI layout, preview functions, and handling different discover models.

classes.name: FirstStartDiscoverModel
classes.description: Model representing the initial state when no repositories are enabled.

classes.name: LoadingDiscoverModel
classes.description: Model representing the loading state during data fetch.

classes.name: LoadedDiscoverModel
classes.description: Model representing the state when discover data is loaded.

classes.name: NoEnabledReposDiscoverModel
classes.description: Model indicating no repositories are enabled.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the discover screen with different UI states.

methods.name: FirstStartDiscoverPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the first start state.

methods.name: LoadingDiscoverPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the loading state.

methods.name: NoEnabledReposPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the no repositories enabled state.
